From booking a slot to therapy at home — Care Manager–led assessment, your plan consent, then a physiotherapist for visits.

Book a home visit

Pick a date and time slot, share your concern and location. No online payment needed to reserve the slot.

We assign a Care Manager for your area who owns assessment, the care plan, and coordinating your visits.

Your care owner

Complimentary assessment

Your Care Manager visits at home (complimentary), understands your condition, and drafts a personalised care plan.

At your door

FAQ

Common questions

Quick details about booking home, clinic, and online physiotherapy with PhysiOkhom.

Book a home visit on PhysiOkhom with your location, date, and time slot. We assign a Care Manager who assesses you at home, builds a care plan, and then assigns a verified physiotherapist for your treatment sessions.

Yes — for home visit bookings. Your Care Manager and assigned physiotherapist come to your address. You can also book a clinic visit or an online consultation if that suits you better.

Yes. PhysiOkhom supports home visits, clinic visits, and online consultations. Choose the mode when you book; your Care Manager and care team guide the next steps for that path.

Yes. Every physiotherapist listed on PhysiOkhom is verified through our platform checks before they can accept bookings. You can also read patient reviews on their profile.

Choose a date and time slot for your home visit. A Care Manager is assigned for a complimentary assessment and creates your care plan. After you consent to the plan in the app, your manager assigns a physiotherapist and treatment begins.

Your Care Manager visits for a complimentary assessment, writes a care plan, and asks for one-tap consent. Once the plan is live, a physiotherapist is assigned for your sessions. You track everything in your dashboard.

Yes. After the complimentary assessment, your Care Manager shares a care plan in the app. One tap to consent makes the plan live — then physio visits and payments follow that plan.

Your Care Manager (or our admin team) assigns a verified physiotherapist after your plan is live. There is no separate physio accept or decline step.

If you are already under an active Care Manager, technique bookings (such as dry needling or cupping) skip a new assessment and care plan. Your manager assigns a physiotherapist for that visit directly.

Common examples include back pain, neck pain, knee pain, post-surgery rehabilitation, and stroke or paralysis support — plus other issues you can describe when booking.

Session fees are collected by your Care Manager after the plan is live — typically by cash or UPI, including PhonePe and other UPI apps. You do not pay online at booking to confirm the slot. Packages and per-session pricing are set in your care plan.
